title: Model serializable constrained text templates
description: Define a versioned `LabelContentTemplate` for constrained text and bundled typography using only serializable application-owned values, with no raw CSS or executable code.
acceptanceCriteria: A template has stable identity, schema version, name, and a serializable text component tree
Text nodes support bounded plain text and documented bundled typography controls
Typography values use closed enums or bounded numeric fields rather than raw CSS
Unknown node types, unknown properties, executable payloads, functions, HTML, and raw CSS are rejected
Text is rendered as text and never interpreted as markup or code
Valid templates round-trip through JSON without losing supported values

steps.details: Create versioned serializable types for template identity, text nodes, bundled font family, weight, size, line spacing, alignment, and bounded content length.
Decode unknown input with an allowlist of node and typography fields; reject extra executable, HTML, event, URL, style-string, or prototype-bearing values.
Provide labeled template name, plain-text, bundled font, weight, size, spacing, and alignment controls whose values map directly to the schema.
Store decoded templates through a feature repository and surface field-associated validation errors without writing invalid partial values.
Round-trip a valid template and reject raw CSS, script-like fields, HTML, unknown nodes, overlong text, unsupported font, and non-finite numeric typography fixtures.

technicalNotes: Use only documented redistributable bundled fonts; custom fonts are out of scope here.
React components are renderers for domain values, not durable template values.
